title: Red Hat Security Advisory: Red Hat build of Keycloak 26.6.9 Security Update
description: A security vulnerability (CVE-2026-117691) affects the Red Hat build of Keycloak 26.6.9, allowing a bypass of SAML redirect binding signature verification via percent-encoded parameter names. This flaw impacts the authentication and single sign-on capabilities provided by Keycloak. Red Hat has issued a security advisory for this issue and recommends updating to the fixed version. No explicit affected versions are stated in the advisory.
